Boundary means an annotation bbox within 2% of image edge. Frozen before download or tested-model calls. No replacements. Interior is a metadata stratum, NOT a clean-delivery guarantee.
source_selection.scope: 20 distinct public photographs with authored notes/orders and synthetic speech. Not model-training holdout, field ground truth, SKU validation or labor-savings measurement. Visual references and targets to be frozen before model calls; uncertain images will not be forced into acceptance targets.

initial_manifest.scope: 20 distinct previously unused SCD validation photos; metadata-stratified convenience sample. Original unmodified photos, authored single-line notes/orders, synthetic receiver audio, exact product-description profile, no trusted SKU identifiers, no ERP writer. Not independent field ground truth, model-training holdout or worker-time study. Mixed/unclear photos remain included; no forced clean labels.
initial_manifest.protocol: One application run per frozen case. No outcome-based input/target/code edits or trial retries. SDK transport retries remain enabled. Every outcome retained, including errors. Count is visible dataset annotations, not hidden contents. Quantity mismatch raises note AND order by one; voice keeps reference count. Earlier gate rules may mask injected faults.
initial_manifest.execution: All cbyp imports from isolated frozen runtime. No credentials copied. Three concurrent cases.
